skill.name: twitter-automation
skill.description: Automate Twitter/X actions through the inference.sh CLI, including posting tweets, creating media posts, liking, retweeting, direct messaging, following users, and reading user or post details.
skill.summary: Run common Twitter/X publishing and engagement workflows with inference.sh app commands.
skill.author: inferen-sh

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command findings are Markdown backticks or app identifiers, not Ruby execution. The skill still contains real infsh and npx command examples that can post, delete, message, follow, install related skills, and contact inference.sh services.

remediation.issue: External account actions can change a Twitter/X account.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before posting, deleting, messaging, liking, retweeting, or following.

remediation.issue: The documentation includes npx skill installation commands.
remediation.suggestion: Move installation to prerequisites, pin trusted sources, and avoid running install commands automatically.

remediation.issue: Automated engagement workflows can be abused for spam or platform manipulation.
remediation.suggestion: Add guardrails against bulk follows, unsolicited DMs, artificial engagement, and other prohibited automation.

remediation.issue: A remote Markdown image can trigger a third-party fetch when rendered.
remediation.suggestion: Use a local marketplace asset or remove the remote image from published documentation.

content.value_statement: Social media teams need repeatable Twitter/X actions without building API scripts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inference.sh CLI commands for posts, media, DMs, follows, and profile lookups.
actual_capabilities: Post text tweets through the x/post-tweet app.
Create Twitter/X posts with media URLs through x/post-create.
Like, retweet, delete, and retrieve posts by tweet ID.
Send direct messages and follow users through inference.sh apps.
Retrieve user profile details by username.
Combine image or video generation apps with Twitter/X posting.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI, login, and a configured Twitter/X integration.
Runs real account actions, so every write action needs user approval.
Does not include a dedicated scheduling command in the visible instructions.
Does not manage Twitter/X policy compliance, rate limits, or consent rules.

use_cases.title: Publish Approved Campaign Posts
use_cases.description: Prepare and post approved Twitter/X updates from a repeatable CLI workflow.

use_cases.title: Test X Integration Workflows
use_cases.description: Run post, profile, and tweet lookup actions while validating an inference.sh integration.

use_cases.title: Create Media Posts
use_cases.description: Generate image or video assets, then publish them with a caption and media URL.

prompt_templates.title: Post a Draft Tweet
prompt_templates.prompt: Post this text to Twitter/X after showing me the exact command and asking for approval: [tweet text].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Media Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Post with an existing media URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Twitter/X post with this media URL and caption. Confirm the account, media URL, and text before running anything.

prompt_templates.title: Review Engagement Actions
prompt_templates.prompt: Like and retweet these tweet IDs only after listing each action for confirmation: [tweet IDs].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Safe Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a safe campaign using tweets, profile lookups, and approved DMs. Separate draft actions from commands I can approve.

output_examples.input: Post a launch announcement after I approve it.
output_examples.output: The assistant drafts the tweet, shows the planned posting command, requests approval, and reports the result after the command finishes.

output_examples.input: Create a post with this media link and caption.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks the media URL, confirms the caption, asks for permission, then publishes the media post through inference.sh.

output_examples.input: Look up this username before following it.
output_examples.output: The assistant retrieves the profile, summarizes key details, and waits for confirmation before running the follow action.

best_practices: Confirm the connected Twitter/X account before every write action.
Review generated text, media URLs, and recipient IDs before running commands.
Use the skill for consent-based workflows that follow Twitter/X rules.
anti_patterns: Do not run bulk follows, likes, retweets, or DMs without explicit consent.
Do not post generated media without verifying rights and accuracy.
Do not treat read-only profile checks as approval for account changes.

faq.question: Does this skill require an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires the inference.sh CLI, login, and a configured Twitter/X integration.

faq.question: Can it post tweets with media?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions use x/post-create with a media URL for image or video posts.

faq.question: Can it send direct messages?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes an x/dm-send workflow for approved direct messages.

faq.question: Does it schedule posts?
faq.answer: No dedicated scheduling command appears in the visible instructions.

faq.question: Can it read tweet or user details?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes commands for tweet lookup and user profile lookup.

faq.question: What approvals should users require?
faq.answer: Require approval before any post, delete, like, retweet, DM, or follow action.
